method: Each text row, including a blank spacer row, occupies the supplied line height. Content height is row count times line height, and travel distance is content height plus one frame height so the first row starts below the frame and the last row clears its top. In speed mode, requested duration is travel distance divided by pixels per second. In duration mode, the requested duration is the supplied target. Duration is rounded to the nearest whole frame at the supplied frame rate, then the frame-aligned speed is travel distance divided by that rounded duration. Movement per frame is travel distance divided by frame count. No font metrics, wrapping, rendered video or drop-frame timecode are inferred.
